text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to designate a student pick-up/drop-off area on the west side of Edwin Avenue, north of Edith Avenue, for St. Rita Catholic School located at No. 178 Edwin Avenue. The pick-up/drop-off area will provide parking for up to 10 minutes during school arrival and dismissal times. This will have a negligible impact on traffic operations.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect, from 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Edwin Avenue, between Edith Avenue and the north end of Edwin Avenue, to operate between Edith Avenue and a point 69 metres north. 2. Authorized the installation of a 10-minute maximum time limit parking in effect, from 8:30 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., and from 3:30 p.m. to 3:45 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Edwin Avenue, between a point 69 metres north of Edith Avenue and the north end of Edwin Avenue. 3. Prohibited parking, from 9:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., and from 3:45 p.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Edwin Avenue, between a point 69 metres north of Edith Avenue and the north end of Edwin Avenue. 4.
